messages:
ashley: Heads-up - Acme trial is hitting 429s during a bulk embeddings import. Happens ~30-40s into their run. link (redacted): https://acme-demo.logs/recent

samir: paste the exact error and headers? embeddings are tiny but high qps can hit per-route request caps.

acme-agent: Customer error: "{\"error\":\"Too many requests\",\"status\":429}"
Headers: x-ratelimit-limit: 120, x-ratelimit-remaining: 0, x-ratelimit-reset: 9

miguel (oncall): default /v1/embeddings route = 120 rpm short window. How many parallel workers?

ashley: they're running 50 parallel uploaders, each batching 5 docs every 6s (small text). They think it's a token budget issue because of monthly quota discussions with sales.

jia: math: 50 workers * (10 batches/min) * 5 docs = 2500 requests/min -> far above 120 rpm. Tokens per doc tiny (~30 tokens) so token-rate is not the limiter; it's request-count.

samir: got it. Sales asked for a short trial bump to 3000 rpm for /v1/embeddings and raise tokens/min to 50k just in case. Need audit note.

samir: applying targeted bump:
```
redwoodctl quotas update --org acme-corp --route /v1/embeddings --rpm 3000 --token-rate 50000 --note "trial bump for Acme embeddings import"
```
Samir: done. Change ID q-99914. Propagating (few seconds).

rate-limiter-bot: Policy apply succeeded for org "acme-corp" (change q-99914). New per-route rpm: 3000. New token_rate_limit: 50000 tokens/min.

ashley: they retried. initial log shows a few lingering 429s immediately after change then clean run.

acme-agent: log: [2026-06-07T10:12:03Z] POST /v1/embeddings 429 x-ratelimit-remaining:0
[2026-06-07T10:12:04Z] POST /v1/embeddings 200 28 tokens

miguel: that first 429 is likely window-edge propagation. Recommend burst capacity for import jobs: add burst_capacity=5000 over 60s so producers don't hit the short window during startup. Also remind customers to use client-side rate limiter (token bucket) for steady ingestion.

jia: agreed. I'll create INF-4680 to add a sales play: "embeddings import quota bump" template + checklist (include TTL, audit entry, monitoring).

samir: applying burst patch now:
```
redwoodctl quotas patch --org acme-corp --route /v1/embeddings --burst_capacity 5000 --burst_window 60 --note "import smoothing for Acme POC"
```
Samir: applied. Change q-99915.

rate-limiter-bot: Burst policy updated for org "acme-corp" (q-99915). burst_capacity: 5000, burst_window: 60s.

ashley: Acme re-ran and said "import completed, errors gone, thanks" :rocket:

miguel: SRE note for playbook: for large imports recommend rpm=1000-5000, burst_capacity scaled to import size (example 5k/60s), token-rate 20k-100k depending on payload. Add client-side bucket to avoid thundering herd on retries.

jia: INF-4680 filed. audit: q-99914, q-99915 recorded; auto-expire in 7 days unless sales requests extension.

ashley: I'll follow up if they want longer. marking POC stage as green from our side. thanks team <3

rate-limiter-bot: Monitoring: org "acme-corp" 1-min error rate decreased from 22% -> 0.7%.
